sd::Status sd::ops::DeclarableOp::validateArguments(Context &block) {
  /*
   * We're checking number of T and I arguments. If number of args is finite number - we check strict equality
   * If number of args is variable (-1), but variables MUST be present - we check for non-zero number of arguments
   */
  if (_descriptor->getNumberOfTArgs() > 0) {
    if ((int)block.getTArguments()->size() < _descriptor->getNumberOfTArgs()) {
      sd_printf("%s: %i T args expected, but %i received\n", this->getOpName()->c_str(),
                _descriptor->getNumberOfTArgs(), block.getTArguments()->size());
      return sd::Status::BAD_PARAMS;
    }
  } else if (_descriptor->getNumberOfTArgs() == -1)
    if (block.getTArguments()->size() == 0) {
      sd_printf("%s: Number of T arguments should be positive number, but got 0 arguments\n",
                this->getOpName()->c_str());
      return sd::Status::BAD_PARAMS;
    }

  if (_descriptor->getNumberOfIArgs() > 0) {
    if ((int)block.getIArguments()->size() < _descriptor->getNumberOfIArgs()) {
      sd_printf("%s: %i int args expected, but %i received\n", this->getOpName()->c_str(),
                _descriptor->getNumberOfIArgs(), block.getIArguments()->size());
      return sd::Status::BAD_PARAMS;
    }
  } else if (_descriptor->getNumberOfIArgs() == -1)
    if (block.getIArguments()->size() == 0) {
      sd_printf("%s: Number of Integer arguments should be positive number, but got 0 arguments\n",
                this->getOpName()->c_str());
      return sd::Status::BAD_PARAMS;
    }

  return sd::Status::OK;
}

sd::Status sd::ops::DeclarableOp::validateInputDimensions(Context &block, int rank) {
  if (block.width() == 0) return sd::Status::OK;

  for (auto p : *block.inputs()) {
    auto v = block.variable(p);
    NDArray *aV = v->getNDArray();

    if (aV == nullptr) return sd::Status::BAD_INPUT;

    if (aV->rankOf() != rank) return sd::Status::BAD_DIMENSIONS;
  }

  return sd::Status::OK;
}

sd::Status sd::ops::DeclarableOp::validateInput2D(Context &block) { return validateInputDimensions(block, 2); }

sd::Status sd::ops::DeclarableOp::validateInput3D(Context &block) { return validateInputDimensions(block, 3); }

sd::Status sd::ops::DeclarableOp::validateInput4D(Context &block) { return validateInputDimensions(block, 4); }

sd::Status sd::ops::DeclarableOp::validateNonEmptyInput(Context &block) {
  if (this->getOpDescriptor()->getNumberOfInputs() == -2 || this->getOpDescriptor()->getNumberOfInputs() == 0)
    return sd::Status::OK;

  if (block.width() < 1 && !block.isFastPath() && block.fastpath_in().size() < 1) {
    sd_printf("%s: no operands provided for the op", this->getOpName()->c_str());
    return sd::Status::BAD_INPUT;
  }

  int cnt = 0;
  for (auto p : *block.inputs()) {
    auto v = block.variable(p);
    if (v == nullptr) {
      if (this->getOpName() != nullptr) {
        sd_printf("Node [%i:<%s>]: Variable [%i] (%i:%i) is NULL\n", block.getNodeId(), this->getOpName()->c_str(), cnt,
                  p.first, p.second);
      } else {
        sd_printf("Node [%i:<noname>]: Variable [%i] (%i:%i) is NULL\n", block.getNodeId(), cnt, p.first, p.second);
      }
      return sd::Status::BAD_INPUT;
    }

    if (v->variableType() == VariableType::NDARRAY) {
      NDArray *aV = v->getNDArray();

      // if array is empty intentionally - we're ok with that
      if (v->hasNDArray() && v->isEmpty()) continue;

      if (aV == nullptr || !aV->nonNull()) {
        if (this->getOpName() != nullptr) {
          sd_printf("Node [%i:<%s>]: NDArray [%i] (%i:%i) is NULL\n", block.getNodeId(), this->getOpName()->c_str(),
                    cnt, p.first, p.second);
        } else {
          sd_printf("Node [%i:<noname>]: NDArray [%i] (%i:%i) is NULL\n", block.getNodeId(), cnt, p.first, p.second);
        }
        return sd::Status::BAD_INPUT;
      }
    }

    cnt++;
  }

  return sd::Status::OK;
}

sd::Status sd::ops::DeclarableOp::validateOrdersMatch(Context &block) {
  if (block.width() == 0) return sd::Status::OK;

  NDArray *a0 = block.variable(0)->getNDArray();
  for (auto p : *block.inputs()) {
    auto v = block.variable(p);
    NDArray *aV = v->getNDArray();
    if (a0->ordering() != aV->ordering()) return sd::Status::BAD_ORDER;
  }

  return sd::Status::OK;
}

sd::Status sd::ops::DeclarableOp::execute(sd::graph::RandomGenerator &rng, const std::vector<NDArray *> &inputs,
                                          const std::vector<NDArray *> &outputs, const std::vector<double> &tArgs,
                                          const std::vector<sd::LongType> &iArgs, const std::vector<bool> &bArgs,
                                          const std::vector<sd::DataType> &dArgs, bool isInplace, sd::DataType type) {
  VariableSpace variableSpace;

  int cnt = -1;
  std::vector<int> in;
  for (auto v : inputs) {
    if (v == nullptr) continue;

    auto var = new Variable(v);
    var->markRemovable(false);
    in.push_back(cnt);
    variableSpace.putVariable(cnt--, var);
  }

  int et = 0;
  for (auto v : outputs) {
    auto var = new Variable(v);
    var->markRemovable(false);
    std::pair<int, int> pair(1, et++);
    variableSpace.putVariable(pair, var);
  }

  Context block(1, &variableSpace, false);
  block.fillInputs(in);
  block.markInplace(isInplace);
  block.setDataType(0, type);

  block.setRng(rng);

  for (size_t e = 0; e < tArgs.size(); e++) block.getTArguments()->emplace_back(tArgs.at(e));

  // FIXME: iargs should be sd::LongType
  for (size_t e = 0; e < iArgs.size(); e++) block.getIArguments()->emplace_back(static_cast<int>(iArgs.at(e)));

  for (size_t e = 0; e < bArgs.size(); e++) block.getBArguments()->push_back(static_cast<int>(bArgs.at(e)));

  for (size_t e = 0; e < dArgs.size(); e++) block.getDArguments()->push_back(dArgs.at(e));

  sd::Status result = this->execute(&block);

sd::Status DeclarableOp::execute(const std::vector<NDArray *> &inputs, const std::vector<NDArray *> &outputs,
                                 const std::vector<double> &tArgs, const std::vector<sd::LongType> &iArgs,
                                 const std::vector<bool> &bArgs, const std::vector<sd::DataType> &dArgs,
                                 bool isInplace) {
  Context ctx(1);

  for (size_t e = 0; e < inputs.size(); e++) {
    ctx.setInputArray(e, inputs[e]);
  }


  for (size_t e = 0; e < outputs.size(); e++) {
    ctx.setOutputArray(e, outputs[e]);
  }


  if (isInplace) ctx.markInplace(isInplace);

  ctx.setIArguments(iArgs);
  ctx.setTArguments(tArgs);
  ctx.setBArguments(bArgs);
  ctx.setDArguments(dArgs);

  return execute(&ctx);
}

sd::ResultSet DeclarableOp::evaluate(const std::vector<NDArray *> &inputs, const std::vector<double> &tArgs,
                                     const std::vector<sd::LongType> &iArgs, const std::vector<bool> &bArgs,
                                     const std::vector<sd::DataType> &dArgs, bool isInplace) {
  VariableSpace variableSpace;

  int cnt = -1;
  std::vector<int> in;
  for (auto v : inputs) {
    if (v == nullptr) continue;

    auto var = new Variable(v);
    var->markRemovable(false);
    in.push_back(cnt);
    variableSpace.putVariable(cnt--, var);
  }

  Context block(1, &variableSpace, false);
  block.setDataType(0, sd::DataType::FLOAT32);
  block.fillInputs(in);
  block.markInplace(isInplace);

/**
 * Environment configuration for kernel selection.
 *
 * Environment Variables:
 *   SD_KERNEL_STRATEGY         - Selection strategy (FASTEST, FIRST_AVAILABLE, ROUND_ROBIN)
 *   SD_KERNEL_AUTOTUNE        - Enable auto-tuning (1/true to enable)
 *   SD_KERNEL_WARMUP_RUNS     - Number of warmup runs (default: 2)
 *   SD_KERNEL_BENCHMARK_RUNS  - Number of benchmark runs (default: 5)
 *   SD_KERNEL_CACHE_PATH      - Path to cache file
 *   SD_KERNEL_FORCE_ENGINE    - Force a specific engine (cpu, cuda, onednn)
 *   SD_KERNEL_DISABLE_ENGINES - Comma-separated list of engines to disable
 *   SD_KERNEL_VERBOSE         - Enable verbose logging (1/true to enable)
 *   SD_KERNEL_PLUGIN_PATH     - Colon-separated plugin search paths
 *   SD_KERNEL_PLUGIN_AUTO     - Auto-load plugins from search paths (1/true)
 */
class SD_LIB_EXPORT KernelSelectionEnvironment {
 private:
  // State is held in a function-local static in the .cpp file
  // to avoid static initialization order fiasco
  static void initialize();

 public:
  /**
   * Check if auto-tuning is enabled
   */
  static bool isAutoTuneEnabled();

  /**
   * Check if verbose logging is enabled
   */
  static bool isVerbose();

  /**
   * Get forced engine (if set)
   */
  static samediff::Engine getForcedEngine();

  /**
   * Check if a specific engine is forced
   */
  static bool hasForcedEngine();

  /**
   * Check if an engine is disabled
   */
  static bool isEngineDisabled(samediff::Engine engine);

  /**
   * Get the cache path
   */
  static const std::string& getCachePath();

  /**
   * Get plugin search paths
   */
  static const std::vector<std::string>& getPluginPaths();

  /**
   * Check if plugin auto-loading is enabled
   */
  static bool isPluginAutoLoadEnabled();

  /**
   * Get engine from string name
   */
  static samediff::Engine engineFromString(const std::string& name);

  /**
   * Get string name from engine
   */
  static std::string engineToString(samediff::Engine engine);

  /**
   * Force re-initialization from environment
   */
  static void reinitialize();
};

   *   - second: the execution status (only valid if first is true)
   */
  static std::pair<bool, Status> dispatchWithAutoTune(DeclarableOp* op, sd::graph::Context& context);
};

Status MultiPlatformDispatcher::executeNativeWithTiming(graph::Context& context) {
  if (_nativeOp == nullptr) {
    return Status::BAD_INPUT;
  }

  auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

  Status status = _nativeOp->execute(&context);

  auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
  double nanos = static_cast<double>(
      std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(end - start).count());

  _stats.recordExecution(samediff::ENGINE_CPU, nanos);

  return status;
}

Status MultiPlatformDispatcher::dispatch(graph::Context& context) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(_mutex);

  // Try to find and execute best helper
  PlatformHelper* helper = selectHelper(context);

  if (helper != nullptr) {
    Status status = executeWithTiming(helper, context);
    if (status == Status::OK) {
      return status;
    }
    // Helper failed, try fallback
  }

  // Fallback to native implementation
  if (_nativeOp != nullptr && KernelSelectionConfig::global().allowFallbackToNative) {
    _stats.fallbackToNative++;
    return executeNativeWithTiming(context);
  }

  return Status::BAD_INPUT;
}

Status MultiPlatformDispatcher::dispatchTo(samediff::Engine engine, graph::Context& context) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(_mutex);

  // Find helper for specified engine
  for (auto* helper : _helpers) {
    if (helper->engine() == engine && helper->isUsable(context)) {
      return executeWithTiming(helper, context);
    }
  }

  // Engine not available, fall back to best available
  return dispatch(context);
}

bool MultiPlatformDispatcher::isUsable(graph::Context& context) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(_mutex);

  for (auto* helper : _helpers) {
    if (helper->isUsable(context)) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return _nativeOp != nullptr;
}

std::string DispatcherStats::toString() const {
  std::stringstream ss;
  ss << "MultiPlatformDispatcher Statistics:\n";
  ss << "  Auto-tune runs: " << autoTuneRuns << "\n";
  ss << "  Cache hits: " << cacheHits << "\n";
  ss << "  Cache misses: " << cacheMisses << "\n";
  ss << "  Fallback to native: " << fallbackToNative << "\n";
  ss << "  Engine usage:\n";

  for (const auto& pair : engineUseCounts) {
    ss << "    Engine " << static_cast<int>(pair.first) << ": "
       << pair.second << " executions";

    auto timeIt = totalTimeByEngine.find(pair.first);
    if (timeIt != totalTimeByEngine.end() && pair.second > 0) {
      ss << ", avg " << (timeIt->second / pair.second / 1000000.0) << " ms";
    }
    ss << "\n";
  }

  return ss.str();
}

bool MultiPlatformDispatcher::isVersionEnforcementEnabled() const {
  return HelperVersionRegistry::getInstance().isStrictVersionEnforcement();
}

std::vector<PlatformHelper*> MultiPlatformDispatcher::getVersionCompatibleHelpers(graph::Context& context) {
  std::vector<PlatformHelper*> compatible;

  for (auto* helper : _helpers) {
    // First check if usable at all
    if (!helper->isUsable(context)) {
      continue;
    }

    // If version enforcement is enabled, check version compatibility
    if (isVersionEnforcementEnabled()) {
      if (!helper->validateRuntimeVersion()) {
        continue;
      }
      if (!helper->hasRequiredCapabilities()) {
        continue;
      }
    }

    compatible.push_back(helper);
  }

  return compatible;
}

   * Get the helper library name (e.g., "cuDNN", "OneDNN")
   */
  std::string helperLibraryName() const { return _helperLibraryName; }

  /**
   * Get minimum required version
   */
  HelperVersion minVersion() const { return _minVersion; }

  /**
   * Get maximum supported version
   */
  HelperVersion maxVersion() const { return _maxVersion; }

  /**
   * Get required capabilities
   */
  HelperCapability requiredCapabilities() const { return _requiredCapabilities; }

  /**
   * Set version requirements (for helpers that need to configure this dynamically)
   */
  void setVersionRequirements(const HelperVersion &minVersion, const HelperVersion &maxVersion) {
    _minVersion = minVersion;
    _maxVersion = maxVersion;
  }

  /**
   * Set required capabilities
   */
  void setRequiredCapabilities(HelperCapability capabilities) { _requiredCapabilities = capabilities; }

  /**
   * Set helper library name
   */
  void setHelperLibraryName(const std::string &name) { _helperLibraryName = name; }

  /**
   * Validate that the runtime version of the helper library meets requirements
   * @return true if version is compatible, false otherwise
   */
  virtual bool validateRuntimeVersion() const {
    if (_helperLibraryName.empty()) {
      // No helper library specified, assume compatible
      return true;
    }

    auto &registry = HelperVersionRegistry::getInstance();
    auto info = registry.getHelperInfo(_helperLibraryName);

    if (!info.available) {
      return false;
    }

    return info.runtime.inRange(_minVersion, _maxVersion);
  }

  /**
   * Check if the helper has all required capabilities
   * @return true if all required capabilities are present
   */
  virtual bool hasRequiredCapabilities() const {
    if (_helperLibraryName.empty() || _requiredCapabilities == HelperCapability::NONE) {
      return true;
    }

    auto &registry = HelperVersionRegistry::getInstance();
    auto info = registry.getHelperInfo(_helperLibraryName);

    if (!info.available) {
      return false;
    }

    return hasCapability(info.capabilities, _requiredCapabilities);
  }

  /**
   * Combined check: version compatible AND has required capabilities
   * Use this in isUsable() implementations for complete validation
   * @param context The execution context
   * @return true if the helper is usable with version checks
   */
  virtual bool isUsableWithVersionCheck(graph::Context &context) {
    // First check version and capabilities
    if (!validateRuntimeVersion()) {
      return false;
    }

    if (!hasRequiredCapabilities()) {
      return false;
    }

    // Then delegate to the actual isUsable check
    return isUsable(context);
  }

  /**
   * Get a detailed status message about version compatibility
   */

// Static registry
static std::mutex _registryMutex;

std::unordered_map<LongType, std::unique_ptr<MultiPlatformDispatcher>>& MultiPlatformDispatcher::getRegistry() {
  static std::unordered_map<LongType, std::unique_ptr<MultiPlatformDispatcher>> registry;
  return registry;
}

MultiPlatformDispatcher* MultiPlatformDispatcher::getOrCreate(const std::string& opName, LongType opHash) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(_registryMutex);

  auto& registry = getRegistry();
  auto it = registry.find(opHash);
  if (it != registry.end()) {
    return it->second.get();
  }

  auto dispatcher = std::make_unique<MultiPlatformDispatcher>(opName, opHash);
  auto* ptr = dispatcher.get();
  registry[opHash] = std::move(dispatcher);
  return ptr;
}

MultiPlatformDispatcher* MultiPlatformDispatcher::get(LongType opHash) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(_registryMutex);

  auto& registry = getRegistry();
  auto it = registry.find(opHash);
  if (it != registry.end()) {
    return it->second.get();
  }
  return nullptr;
}

bool MultiPlatformDispatcher::exists(LongType opHash) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(_registryMutex);
  return getRegistry().find(opHash) != getRegistry().end();
}

MultiPlatformDispatcher::MultiPlatformDispatcher(const std::string& opName, LongType opHash,
                                                   DeclarableOp* nativeOp)
    : _opName(opName), _opHash(opHash), _nativeOp(nativeOp), _mode(DispatchMode::AUTO) {
  // Default engine priority
  _enginePriority = {samediff::ENGINE_CUDA, samediff::ENGINE_ONEDNN,
                     samediff::ENGINE_CPU};
}

void MultiPlatformDispatcher::addHelper(PlatformHelper* helper) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(_mutex);

  // Check if helper already exists
  for (auto* h : _helpers) {
    if (h == helper || h->engine() == helper->engine()) {
      return;  // Already have a helper for this engine
    }
  }

  _helpers.push_back(helper);
}

void MultiPlatformDispatcher::removeHelper(PlatformHelper* helper) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(_mutex);
  _helpers.erase(std::remove(_helpers.begin(), _helpers.end(), helper), _helpers.end());
}

std::vector<samediff::Engine> MultiPlatformDispatcher::getAvailableEngines() const {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(_mutex);

  std::vector<samediff::Engine> engines;
  for (auto* helper : _helpers) {
    engines.push_back(helper->engine());
  }

  // Always include CPU as fallback
  if (std::find(engines.begin(), engines.end(), samediff::ENGINE_CPU) == engines.end()) {
    engines.push_back(samediff::ENGINE_CPU);
  }

  return engines;
}

bool MultiPlatformDispatcher::hasEngine(samediff::Engine engine) const {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(_mutex);

  for (auto* helper : _helpers) {
    if (helper->engine() == engine) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return engine == samediff::ENGINE_CPU;  // CPU is always available
}

std::vector<PlatformHelper*> MultiPlatformDispatcher::getUsableHelpers(graph::Context& context) {
  std::vector<PlatformHelper*> usable;

  for (auto* helper : _helpers) {
    if (helper->isUsable(context)) {
      usable.push_back(helper);
    }
  }

  return usable;
}

PlatformHelper* MultiPlatformDispatcher::selectHelper(graph::Context& context) {
  auto usable = getUsableHelpers(context);

  if (usable.empty()) {
    return nullptr;
  }

  if (usable.size() == 1) {
    return usable[0];
  }

  switch (_mode) {
    case DispatchMode::AUTO: {
      // Use auto-tuner to select best
      std::vector<KernelExecutor*> executors;
      std::vector<std::unique_ptr<PlatformHelperExecutor>> ownedExecutors;

      for (auto* helper : usable) {
        auto executor = std::make_unique<PlatformHelperExecutor>(helper);
        executors.push_back(executor.get());
        ownedExecutors.push_back(std::move(executor));
      }

      auto* best = KernelAutoTuner::getInstance().selectBest(context, executors, _opHash);
      if (best != nullptr) {
        // Find the matching helper
        for (auto* helper : usable) {
          if (helper->engine() == best->getEngine()) {
            return helper;
          }
        }
      }
      return usable[0];
    }

    case DispatchMode::FIXED: {
      // Use priority order
      for (auto engine : _enginePriority) {
        for (auto* helper : usable) {
          if (helper->engine() == engine) {
            return helper;
          }
        }
      }
      return usable[0];
    }

    case DispatchMode::ROUND_ROBIN: {
      int index = _roundRobinIndex.fetch_add(1) % static_cast<int>(usable.size());
      return usable[index];
    }

    case DispatchMode::BENCHMARK: {
      // Always benchmark, don't cache
      std::vector<KernelExecutor*> executors;
      std::vector<std::unique_ptr<PlatformHelperExecutor>> ownedExecutors;

      for (auto* helper : usable) {
        auto executor = std::make_unique<PlatformHelperExecutor>(helper);
        executors.push_back(executor.get());
        ownedExecutors.push_back(std::move(executor));
      }

      auto results = KernelAutoTuner::getInstance().benchmarkAll(context, executors);
      if (!results.empty() && results[0].success) {
        for (auto* helper : usable) {
          if (helper->engine() == results[0].engine) {
            return helper;
          }
        }
      }
      return usable[0];
    }
  }

  return usable[0];
}

  Status status = helper->invokeHelper(context);

  auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
  double nanos = static_cast<double>(
      std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(end - start).count());

// Use lazy initialization to avoid static initialization order fiasco.
// All state is wrapped in a function-local static struct that's only
// initialized on first access.
struct KernelSelectionState {
  bool initialized = false;
  bool autoTuneEnabled = false;
  bool verbose = false;
  samediff::Engine forcedEngine = samediff::ENGINE_CPU;
  bool hasForcedEngine = false;
  std::vector<samediff::Engine> disabledEngines;
  std::string cachePath;
  std::vector<std::string> pluginPaths;
  bool pluginAutoLoad = false;
};

static KernelSelectionState& getState() {
  static KernelSelectionState state;
  return state;
}

void KernelSelectionEnvironment::initialize() {
  auto& state = getState();
  if (state.initialized) return;

  // SD_KERNEL_AUTOTUNE
  const char* autoTuneEnv = std::getenv("SD_KERNEL_AUTOTUNE");
  if (autoTuneEnv != nullptr) {
    std::string val(autoTuneEnv);
    state.autoTuneEnabled = (val == "1" || val == "true" || val == "TRUE");
  }

  // SD_KERNEL_VERBOSE
  const char* verboseEnv = std::getenv("SD_KERNEL_VERBOSE");
  if (verboseEnv != nullptr) {
    std::string val(verboseEnv);
    state.verbose = (val == "1" || val == "true" || val == "TRUE");
  }

  // SD_KERNEL_FORCE_ENGINE
  const char* forceEnv = std::getenv("SD_KERNEL_FORCE_ENGINE");
  if (forceEnv != nullptr) {
    state.forcedEngine = engineFromString(forceEnv);
    state.hasForcedEngine = true;
  }

  // SD_KERNEL_DISABLE_ENGINES
  const char* disableEnv = std::getenv("SD_KERNEL_DISABLE_ENGINES");
  if (disableEnv != nullptr) {
    std::string val(disableEnv);
    std::stringstream ss(val);
    std::string engine;
    while (std::getline(ss, engine, ',')) {
      // Trim whitespace
      engine.erase(0, engine.find_first_not_of(" \t"));
      engine.erase(engine.find_last_not_of(" \t") + 1);
      if (!engine.empty()) {
        state.disabledEngines.push_back(engineFromString(engine));
      }
    }
  }

  // SD_KERNEL_CACHE_PATH
  const char* cacheEnv = std::getenv("SD_KERNEL_CACHE_PATH");
  if (cacheEnv != nullptr) {
    state.cachePath = cacheEnv;
    KernelPerformanceRegistry::getInstance().setCachePath(state.cachePath);
    KernelPerformanceRegistry::getInstance().loadFromFile(state.cachePath);
  }

  // SD_KERNEL_PLUGIN_PATH
  const char* pluginPathEnv = std::getenv("SD_KERNEL_PLUGIN_PATH");
  if (pluginPathEnv != nullptr) {
    std::string val(pluginPathEnv);
#ifdef _WIN32
    char delimiter = ';';
#else
    char delimiter = ':';
#endif
    std::stringstream ss(val);
    std::string path;
    while (std::getline(ss, path, delimiter)) {
      if (!path.empty()) {
        state.pluginPaths.push_back(path);
      }
    }
  }

  // SD_KERNEL_PLUGIN_AUTO
  const char* pluginAutoEnv = std::getenv("SD_KERNEL_PLUGIN_AUTO");
  if (pluginAutoEnv != nullptr) {
    std::string val(pluginAutoEnv);
    state.pluginAutoLoad = (val == "1" || val == "true" || val == "TRUE");
  }

  // Configure the global KernelSelectionConfig
  const char* warmupEnv = std::getenv("SD_KERNEL_WARMUP_RUNS");
  if (warmupEnv != nullptr) {
    try {
      KernelSelectionConfig::global().warmupRuns = std::stoi(warmupEnv);
    } catch (...) {
      // Ignore invalid value
    }
  }

  const char* benchmarkEnv = std::getenv("SD_KERNEL_BENCHMARK_RUNS");
  if (benchmarkEnv != nullptr) {
    try {
      KernelSelectionConfig::global().benchmarkRuns = std::stoi(benchmarkEnv);
    } catch (...) {
      // Ignore invalid value
    }
  }

  KernelSelectionConfig::global().verbose = state.verbose;

  state.initialized = true;
}

bool KernelSelectionEnvironment::isAutoTuneEnabled() {
  initialize();
  return getState().autoTuneEnabled;
}

bool KernelSelectionEnvironment::isVerbose() {
  initialize();
  return getState().verbose;
}

samediff::Engine KernelSelectionEnvironment::getForcedEngine() {
  initialize();
  return getState().forcedEngine;
}

bool KernelSelectionEnvironment::hasForcedEngine() {
  initialize();
  return getState().hasForcedEngine;
}

bool KernelSelectionEnvironment::isEngineDisabled(samediff::Engine engine) {
  initialize();
  auto& state = getState();
  return std::find(state.disabledEngines.begin(), state.disabledEngines.end(), engine) !=
         state.disabledEngines.end();
}

const std::string& KernelSelectionEnvironment::getCachePath() {
  initialize();
  return getState().cachePath;
}

const std::vector<std::string>& KernelSelectionEnvironment::getPluginPaths() {
  initialize();
  return getState().pluginPaths;
}

bool KernelSelectionEnvironment::isPluginAutoLoadEnabled() {
  initialize();
  return getState().pluginAutoLoad;
}

samediff::Engine KernelSelectionEnvironment::engineFromString(const std::string& name) {
  std::string lower = name;
  std::transform(lower.begin(), lower.end(), lower.begin(), ::tolower);

  if (lower == "cpu" || lower == "native") {
    return samediff::ENGINE_CPU;
  } else if (lower == "cuda" || lower == "gpu") {
    return samediff::ENGINE_CUDA;
  } else if (lower == "onednn" || lower == "mkldnn" || lower == "mkl") {
    return samediff::ENGINE_ONEDNN;
  }

  return samediff::ENGINE_CPU;
}

std::string KernelSelectionEnvironment::engineToString(samediff::Engine engine) {
  switch (engine) {
    case samediff::ENGINE_CPU:
      return "CPU";
    case samediff::ENGINE_CUDA:
      return "CUDA";
    case samediff::ENGINE_ONEDNN:
      return "oneDNN";
    default:
      return "Unknown";
  }
}

void KernelSelectionEnvironment::reinitialize() {
  auto& state = getState();
  state.initialized = false;
  state.disabledEngines.clear();
  state.pluginPaths.clear();
  initialize();
}

// KernelDispatchHelper implementation

bool KernelDispatchHelper::shouldUseHelper(DeclarableOp* op, sd::graph::Context& context) {
  if (op == nullptr) return false;

  // Check if we have any helpers for this operation
  auto& registrator = OpRegistrator::getInstance();
  LongType hash = op->getOpHash();

  if (!registrator.hasAnyHelper(hash)) {
    return false;
  }

  // Check forced engine
  if (KernelSelectionEnvironment::hasForcedEngine()) {
    samediff::Engine forced = KernelSelectionEnvironment::getForcedEngine();
    if (registrator.hasHelper(hash, forced)) {
      auto* helper = registrator.getPlatformHelper(hash, forced);
      return helper != nullptr && helper->isUsable(context);
    }
    return false;
  }

  // Check available helpers
  auto helpers = registrator.getAllHelpersForOp(hash);
  for (auto* helper : helpers) {
    if (!KernelSelectionEnvironment::isEngineDisabled(helper->engine()) &&
        helper->isUsable(context)) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}

std::pair<bool, Status> KernelDispatchHelper::dispatchWithAutoTune(DeclarableOp* op, sd::graph::Context& context) {
  if (op == nullptr) {
    return {false, Status::BAD_INPUT};
  }

  auto& registrator = OpRegistrator::getInstance();
  LongType hash = op->getOpHash();

  // Debug: Log helper dispatch attempts
  sd_debug("KernelDispatch: op=%s hash=%lld\n", op->getOpName()->c_str(), hash);

  // If forced engine, use that
  if (KernelSelectionEnvironment::hasForcedEngine()) {
    samediff::Engine forced = KernelSelectionEnvironment::getForcedEngine();
    sd_debug("KernelDispatch: forced engine=%d\n", (int)forced);
    if (registrator.hasHelper(hash, forced)) {
      auto* helper = registrator.getPlatformHelper(hash, forced);
      if (helper != nullptr && helper->isUsable(context)) {
        sd_debug("KernelDispatch: using forced helper %s\n", helper->name().c_str());
        Status status = helper->invokeHelper(context);
        return {true, status};
      }
    }
    return {false, Status::OK};  // Fall back to native
  }

  // Get all usable helpers
  auto allHelpers = registrator.getAllHelpersForOp(hash);
  sd_debug("KernelDispatch: found %zu helpers for op\n", allHelpers.size());

  std::vector<platforms::PlatformHelper*> usableHelpers;

  for (auto* helper : allHelpers) {
    bool engineDisabled = KernelSelectionEnvironment::isEngineDisabled(helper->engine());
    bool isUsable = helper->isUsable(context);
    sd_debug("KernelDispatch: helper=%s engine=%d disabled=%d usable=%d\n",
             helper->name().c_str(), (int)helper->engine(), engineDisabled, isUsable);
    if (!engineDisabled && isUsable) {
      usableHelpers.push_back(helper);
    }
  }

  sd_debug("KernelDispatch: %zu usable helpers\n", usableHelpers.size());

  if (usableHelpers.empty()) {
    return {false, Status::OK};  // No usable helpers, fall back to native
  }

  // If only one helper, use it
  if (usableHelpers.size() == 1) {
    Status status = usableHelpers[0]->invokeHelper(context);
    return {true, status};
  }

  // If auto-tuning is not enabled, use first available
  if (!KernelSelectionEnvironment::isAutoTuneEnabled()) {
    Status status = usableHelpers[0]->invokeHelper(context);
    return {true, status};
  }

  // Use auto-tuning to select best kernel
  std::vector<KernelExecutor*> executors;
  std::vector<std::unique_ptr<PlatformHelperExecutor>> ownedExecutors;

  for (auto* helper : usableHelpers) {
    auto executor = std::make_unique<PlatformHelperExecutor>(helper);
    executors.push_back(executor.get());
    ownedExecutors.push_back(std::move(executor));
  }

  auto* bestExecutor = KernelAutoTuner::getInstance().selectBest(context, executors, hash);
  if (bestExecutor != nullptr) {
    Status status = bestExecutor->execute(context);
    return {true, status};
  }

  // Fallback
  Status status = usableHelpers[0]->invokeHelper(context);
  return {true, status};
}

namespace platforms {

//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
// MATMUL - Matrix multiplication on CUDA
static void matmulCuda(NDArray* a, NDArray* b, NDArray* c) {
    llamacppUtils::GgmlCudaContextGuard ctx(128 * 1024 * 1024);

    struct ggml_tensor* ggml_a = llamacppUtils::createGgmlTensorCuda(ctx, a, ctx.getBackend(), "a");
    struct ggml_tensor* ggml_b = llamacppUtils::createGgmlTensorCuda(ctx, b, ctx.getBackend(), "b");

    struct ggml_tensor* ggml_c = ggml_mul_mat(ctx, ggml_a, ggml_b);
    ggml_set_name(ggml_c, "c");

    struct ggml_cgraph* graph = ggml_new_graph(ctx);
    ggml_build_forward_expand(graph, ggml_c);
    llamacppUtils::executeGgmlGraphCuda(ctx, graph, ctx.getBackend());

    llamacppUtils::copyGgmlCudaToNDArray(ggml_c, c, ctx.getBackend());
}

PLATFORM_IMPL(matmul, ENGINE_CUDA) {
    auto a = INPUT_VARIABLE(0);
    auto b = INPUT_VARIABLE(1);
    auto c = OUTPUT_VARIABLE(0);

    if (a->isEmpty() || b->isEmpty()) return sd::Status::OK;

    matmulCuda(a, b, c);
    return sd::Status::OK;
}

PLATFORM_IMPL(matmul, ENGINE_CPU) {
  auto x = INPUT_VARIABLE(0);
  auto y = INPUT_VARIABLE(1);
  auto z = OUTPUT_VARIABLE(0);

  if (x->isEmpty() || y->isEmpty()) return sd::Status::OK;

  sd::LongType iSize = (sd::LongType)block.getIArguments()->size();
  int transX = iSize > 0 ? INT_ARG(0) : 0;
  int transY = iSize > 1 ? INT_ARG(1) : 0;
  const int transZ = iSize > 2 ? INT_ARG(2) : 0;

  // optional use alpha nad beta
  iSize = (sd::LongType)block.getTArguments()->size();
  float alpha = iSize > 0 ? T_ARG(0) : 1.0;
  float beta = iSize > 1 ? T_ARG(1) : 0.0;

  const sd::LongType xRank = x->rankOf();
  const sd::LongType yRank = y->rankOf();
  const sd::LongType zRank = z->rankOf();

  if (transZ) {
    x = INPUT_VARIABLE(1);
    y = INPUT_VARIABLE(0);
    bool temp = transX;
    transX = !transY;
    transY = !temp;
  }

  const sd::LongType xLastDim = transX ? -2 : -1;
  const sd::LongType yLastDim = transY ? -2 : -1;
  const sd::LongType xLastButOneDim = transX ? -1 : -2;
  const sd::LongType yLastButOneDim = transY ? -1 : -2;

  // ******* input validation ******* //
  REQUIRE_TRUE(xRank > 0 && yRank > 0, 0,
               "MATMUL MKLDNN OP: input arrays must have rank bigger than 0 (should not be scalars), but got instead: "
               "x rank = %i, y rank = %i !",
               xRank, yRank);

  if (xRank == 1 && yRank == 1) {  // dot case, output is scalar (or vector with length = 1)
    REQUIRE_TRUE(x->lengthOf() == y->lengthOf(), 0,
                 "MATMUL MKLDNN OP: since input arrays are vectors they must have the same length, but got x length = "
                 "%i, y length = %i !",
                 x->lengthOf(), y->lengthOf());
  } else if (xRank == 1 && yRank == 2) {  // vector x matrix, i.e. [4] x [4,5] = [5], output is vector
    REQUIRE_TRUE(x->lengthOf() == y->sizeAt(yLastButOneDim), 0,
                 "MATMUL MKLDNN OP: input arrays have inconsistent shapes for vector-matrix product: x %s, y %s !",
                 ShapeUtils::shapeAsString(x).c_str(), ShapeUtils::shapeAsString(y).c_str());
  } else if (xRank == 2 && yRank == 1) {  // matrix x vector , i.e. [4,5] x [5] = [4], output is vector
    REQUIRE_TRUE(x->sizeAt(xLastDim) == y->lengthOf(), 0,
                 "MATMUL MKLDNN OP: input arrays have inconsistent shapes for matrix-vector product: x %s, y %s !",
                 ShapeUtils::shapeAsString(x).c_str(), ShapeUtils::shapeAsString(y).c_str());
  } else {
    REQUIRE_TRUE(xRank == yRank && yRank == zRank, 0,
                 "MATMUL MKLDNN OP: input and output arrays must have the same rank, but got instead: x rank = %i, y "
                 "rank = %i, z rank = %i !",
                 xRank, yRank, zRank);
    REQUIRE_TRUE(
        x->sizeAt(xLastDim) == y->sizeAt(yLastButOneDim) && x->sizeAt(xLastButOneDim) == z->sizeAt(-2) &&
            y->sizeAt(yLastDim) == z->sizeAt(-1),
        0, "MATMUL MKLDNN OP: input/output arrays have inconsistent shapes for matrix product: x %s, y %s, z %s !",
        ShapeUtils::shapeAsString(x).c_str(), ShapeUtils::shapeAsString(y).c_str(),
        ShapeUtils::shapeAsString(z).c_str());

    if (xRank > 2)  // outer dims must be the same
      for (int i = 0; i < xRank - 2; ++i)
        REQUIRE_TRUE(
            x->sizeAt(i) == y->sizeAt(i) && y->sizeAt(i) == z->sizeAt(i), 0,
            "MATMUL MKLDNN OP: input/output arrays have inconsistent shapes for matrix product: x %s, y %s, z %s !",
            ShapeUtils::shapeAsString(x).c_str(), ShapeUtils::shapeAsString(y).c_str(),
            ShapeUtils::shapeAsString(z).c_str());
  }
  // ******* end of input validation ******* //

  matmulMKLDNN(x, y, z, transX, transY, alpha, beta);

  return sd::Status::OK;
}

    int transA = 0;
    int transB = 0;

    if (block.getIArguments()->size() > 0)
        transA = INT_ARG(0);
    if (block.getIArguments()->size() > 1)
        transB = INT_ARG(1);

    // Get alpha/beta from T arguments (default to 1.0 and 0.0)
    double alpha = 1.0;
    double beta = 0.0;

    if (block.getTArguments()->size() > 0)
        alpha = T_ARG(0);
    if (block.getTArguments()->size() > 1)
        beta = T_ARG(1);

    // Handle batch matmul for 3D+ tensors
    if (a->rankOf() > 2) {
        // For batched operations, we need to iterate over the batch dimensions
        // This is a simplified implementation - for optimal performance,
        // consider using vDSP batch operations
        auto aReshape = a->reshape(a->ordering(), {-1, a->sizeAt(-2), a->sizeAt(-1)});
        auto bReshape = b->reshape(b->ordering(), {-1, b->sizeAt(-2), b->sizeAt(-1)});
        auto cReshape = c->reshape(c->ordering(), {-1, c->sizeAt(-2), c->sizeAt(-1)});

        LongType batchSize = aReshape.sizeAt(0);

        for (LongType i = 0; i < batchSize; i++) {
            auto aSub = aReshape.subarray({NDIndex::point(i), NDIndex::all(), NDIndex::all()});
            auto bSub = bReshape.subarray({NDIndex::point(i), NDIndex::all(), NDIndex::all()});
            auto cSub = cReshape.subarray({NDIndex::point(i), NDIndex::all(), NDIndex::all()});

            matmulAccelerate(&aSub, &bSub, &cSub, transA != 0, transB != 0, alpha, beta);
        }
    } else {
        // Standard 2D matrix multiplication
        matmulAccelerate(a, b, c, transA != 0, transB != 0, alpha, beta);
    }

    return sd::Status::OK;
}

   945	sd::Status sd::ops::DeclarableOp::execute(Context *block) {
   946	  sd_debug("Executing op: [%s]\n", this->getOpName()->c_str());
   947	
   948	  std::chrono::time_point<std::chrono::system_clock> timeEnter, timeStart, timeEnd;
   949	  sd::LongType prepTime, outerTime;
   950	
   951	  // Op Timing Tracker setup
   952	  auto& timingTracker = graph::OpTimingTracker::getInstance();
   953	  const bool doTiming = timingTracker.isEnabled();
   954	  const bool doDetailedTiming = doTiming && timingTracker.isDetailedMode();
   955	  graph::OpTimingRecord timingRecord{};
   956	  std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::time_point timingStart;
   957	
   958	  if (doTiming) {
   959	    timingRecord.hash = this->getOpHash();
   960	    const std::string* opNamePtr = this->getOpName();
   961	    if (opNamePtr != nullptr) {
   962	      size_t copyLen = std::min(opNamePtr->length(), graph::OP_NAME_MAX_LEN - 1);
   963	      std::memcpy(timingRecord.name, opNamePtr->c_str(), copyLen);
   964	      timingRecord.name[copyLen] = '\0';
   965	    }
   966	    timingRecord.threadId = std::this_thread::get_id();
   967	    timingRecord.timestampNanos = timingTracker.getTraceTimestamp();
   968	    timingStart = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
   969	
   970	    // Enter indirect helper tracking - track when nested ops use helpers
   971	    graph::getIndirectHelperTracker().enter();
   972	  }
   973	
   974	  sd::LongType memoryBefore =
   975	      block->workspace() == nullptr ? 0L : block->workspace()->getSpilledSize() + block->workspace()->getUsedSize();
   976	  if (Environment::getInstance().isProfiling()) timeEnter = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
   977	
   978	  // Phase: VALIDATION
   979	  {
   980	    graph::OpPhaseTimer validationTimer(doDetailedTiming ? &timingRecord : nullptr, graph::OpPhase::VALIDATION);
   981	    // basic validation: ensure inputs are set
   982	    REQUIRE_OK(this->validateNonEmptyInput(*block));
   983	    // ensure number of IArgs, TArgs match our expectations
   984	    REQUIRE_OK(this->validateArguments(*block));
   985	    // validating data types for inputs and (optionally) outputs
   986	    REQUIRE_OK(this->validateDataTypes(*block));
   987	  }
   988	
   989	  // Phase: MEMORY_ALLOC - allocate output NDArrays
   990	  int numOutputs;
   991	  {
   992	    graph::OpPhaseTimer allocTimer(doDetailedTiming ? &timingRecord : nullptr, graph::OpPhase::MEMORY_ALLOC);
   993	    numOutputs = this->prepareOutputs(*block);
   994	  }
   995	
   996	  if (Environment::getInstance().isProfiling()) {
   997	    timeStart = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
   998	    prepTime = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(timeStart - timeEnter).count();
   999	  }
  1000	
  1001	  sd::Status status;
  1002	  bool hasHelper = false;
  1003	
  1004	#if defined(SD_GCC_FUNCTRACE)
  1005	  // Log operation start before execution
  1006	  // Note: Java stack trace would be captured via Context if available
  1007	  std::string javaStackTrace = "";  // TODO: Get from Context if Java side sets it
  1008	  OpExecutionLogger::getInstance().logOpStart(this->getOpName()->c_str(), block, javaStackTrace);
  1009	  // Set current op name for lifecycle trackers to capture
  1010	  OpExecutionLogger::setCurrentOpName(*this->getOpName());
  1011	#endif
  1012	
  1013	  // Wrap execution in try-catch to dump stack traces on exceptions
  1014	#ifdef __cpp_exceptions
  1015	  try {
  1016	    // platform helpers use might be forbidden for various reasons, so we'll check it out first
  1017	    if (block->helpersAllowed() && sd::Environment::getInstance().helpersAllowed()) {
  1018	      // Use the new multi-backend kernel selection infrastructure
  1019	      // This will auto-tune and select the best available backend helper
  1020	      {
  1021	        graph::OpPhaseTimer helperCheckTimer(doDetailedTiming ? &timingRecord : nullptr, graph::OpPhase::HELPER_CHECK);
  1022	        graph::OpPhaseTimer helperExecTimer(doDetailedTiming ? &timingRecord : nullptr, graph::OpPhase::HELPER_EXEC);
  1023	
  1024	        auto dispatchResult = platforms::KernelDispatchHelper::dispatchWithAutoTune(this, *block);
  1025	        if (dispatchResult.first) {
  1026	          // A helper was used successfully
  1027	          status = dispatchResult.second;
  1028	          hasHelper = true;
  1029	          timingRecord.usedHelper = true;
  1030	          // Mark helper used for indirect tracking - parent ops will see this
  1031	          graph::getIndirectHelperTracker().markHelperUsed();
  1032	        }
  1033	      }
  1034	    }
  1035	
  1036	    if (!hasHelper) {
  1037	      // Phase: NATIVE_EXEC
  1038	      graph::OpPhaseTimer nativeExecTimer(doDetailedTiming ? &timingRecord : nullptr, graph::OpPhase::NATIVE_EXEC);

  1041	
  1042	#if defined(SD_GCC_FUNCTRACE)
  1043	    // Log successful execution
  1044	    if (status == sd::Status::OK) {
  1045	      OpExecutionLogger::getInstance().logOpSuccess(this->getOpName()->c_str(), block);

   260	sd::NDArray *sd::ops::DeclarableOp::getZ(Context &ctx, int inputId) {
   261	  NDArray *z = nullptr;
   262	
   263	  if (ctx.isFastPath()) {
   264	    if (ctx.fastpath_out().size() <= static_cast<size_t>(inputId)) {
   265	      if (ctx.isInplace()) {
   266	        z = ctx.fastpath_in()[inputId];
   267	      } else
   268	        THROW_EXCEPTION("fastpath_out: unresolved output array");
   269	    } else {
   270	      z = ctx.fastpath_out()[inputId];
   271	    }
   272	  } else {
   273	    std::pair<int, int> pair(ctx.nodeId(), inputId);
   274	
   275	    if (ctx.isInplace()) {
   276	      z = ctx.variable(inputId)->getNDArray();
   277	
   278	      // hypothetically it's possible to have no variable. chances are low, but who knows. let's just create it for now
   279	      if (!ctx.getVariableSpace()->hasVariable(pair)) {
   280	        auto var = new Variable();
   281	        ctx.getVariableSpace()->putVariable(pair, var);
   282	      }
   283	
   284	      // now we're saving input array as output array
   285	      auto var = ctx.getVariableSpace()->getVariable(pair);
   286	      var->markRemovable(false);
   287	      var->setNDArray(z);
   288	    } else if (!ctx.isInplace()) {
   289	      auto var = ctx.variable(pair);
   290	      if (var->getNDArray() != nullptr && var->getNDArray()->nonNull()) {
   291	        z = var->getNDArray();
   292	      } else {
   293	        sd_printf("Can't get Z variable for node_%i!\n", ctx.nodeId());
   294	      }
   295	    } else {
   296	      THROW_EXCEPTION("getZ: Unable to return z variable!");
   297	    }
   298	  }
   299	
   300	  return z;
   301	}

   438	void Context::pushNDArrayToVariableSpace(std::pair<int, int> &pair, NDArray *array, bool removable) {
   439	  if (_variableSpace != nullptr) {
   440	    if (!_variableSpace->hasVariable(pair)) {
   441	      auto var = new Variable(array, nullptr, pair.first, pair.second);
   442	      _variableSpace->putVariable(pair, var);
   443	      var->markRemovable(removable);
   444	    } else {
   445	      sd_debug("Context: Getting variable in push ndarray\n",0);
   446	      auto var = _variableSpace->getVariable(pair);
   447	      sd_debug("Context: After getting variable in push ndarray to variable space\n",0);
   448	      if (var->hasNDArray()) {
   449	        if (var->getNDArray() != array) {
   450	          if (var->isRemovable() && var->hasNDArray() && !var->getNDArray()->isView()) {
   451	            delete var->getNDArray();
   452	          }
   453	          var->setNDArray(array);
   454	          var->markRemovable(removable);
   455	        }
   456	      } else {
   457	        var->setNDArray(array);
   458	        var->markRemovable(removable);
   459	      }
   460	    }
   461	  }
   462	}

codex
`Context::setInputArray` and `setOutputArray` only grow the vectors; they never shrink them. `width()` and `outputWidth()` are raw vector sizes. That means a reused DSP context can absolutely retain stale optional inputs/outputs unless something explicitly calls `clearFastPath()`, and I haven’t found DSP doing that. I’m checking whether the standard path purges contexts between ops, because that would make this a real DSP-vs-standard behavior difference rather than a generic Context issue.

codex
The contrast with the standard path is now clear in source: reused Java `OpContext`s are purged before they go back into the pool, and that native purge maps to `Context::clearFastPath()` / `clearFastPathNoSync()`. DSP’s pooled contexts are reused too, but I still haven’t found any equivalent purge in the DSP slot executor. I’m pulling the reuse path to make that explicit, then I’ll synthesize the likely impact on attention.

The attention op confirms the tail-risk directly: optional inputs are gated only by `block.width() > N`, and optional present-K/V outputs are gated only by `block.outputWidth() > N`. If DSP leaves stale tail entries in `fastpath_in/out`, the op can start believing optional tensors exist when the current slot wiring did not provide them. I’m checking `Context::array()` to confirm it will just return those stale pointers without any additional validity guard.

codex
`Context::array(idx)` confirms it: if `_fastpath_in.size() > idx`, it returns `_fastpath_in[idx]` directly. There is no notion of “current logical arity”; the vector length is the arity. So stale tail entries are semantically visible to ops, not just dead storage. I’m doing one last pass on `OUTPUT_VARIABLE`/`getZ()` and the DSP frozen path, then I can give you a source-backed ranking of the context fields that actually matter here.

    37	// Block sizes for tiling - tuned for modern GPUs (Ada Lovelace / Ampere)
    38	// RTX 4090: 128 SMs, 100KB shared memory per SM, 1 TB/s memory bandwidth
    39	constexpr int TILE_SIZE_Q = 64;   // Query tile size (increased from 32)
    40	constexpr int TILE_SIZE_KV = 64;  // Key/Value tile size (increased from 32)
    41	constexpr int WARP_SIZE = 32;
    42	constexpr int DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZE = 512;  // Increased from 256 for better occupancy

    44	//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    45	// In-place causal mask kernel - sets scores[b, i, j] = -inf where j > i
    46	// This replaces: create mask array + nullify + fillAsTriangular + broadcast add
    47	//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    48	template <typename T>
    49	__global__ void applyCausalMaskInPlaceKernel(
    50	   T* __restrict__ scores,  // [batch, seqQ, seqKV]
    51	   const LongType batch,
    52	   const LongType seqQ,
    53	   const LongType seqKV) {
    54	
    55	 const LongType totalElements = batch * seqQ * seqKV;
    56	 const LongType tid = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    57	 const LongType causalOffset = (seqKV > seqQ) ? (seqKV - seqQ) : 0;
    58	
    59	 for (LongType idx = tid; idx < totalElements; idx += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {
    60	   // Convert linear index to (b, i, j)
    61	   const LongType j = idx % seqKV;
    62	   const LongType i = (idx / seqKV) % seqQ;
    63	   // const LongType b = idx / (seqQ * seqKV);  // not needed
    64	
    65	   // Decode-aware causal mask:
    66	   // prefill (seqQ == seqKV): allow j <= i
    67	   // decode  (seqQ == 1): allow all past keys via offset.
    68	   if (j > (i + causalOffset)) {
    69	     scores[idx] = static_cast<T>(-1.0e9f);
    70	   }
    71	 }
    72	}
    73	
    74	template <typename T>
    75	static void applyCausalMaskInPlaceLauncher(const int blocksPerGrid, const int threadsPerBlock,
    76	                                          const cudaStream_t* stream, void* vScores,
    77	                                          LongType batch, LongType seqQ, LongType seqKV) {
    78	 auto scores = reinterpret_cast<T*>(vScores);
    79	 applyCausalMaskInPlaceKernel<T><<<blocksPerGrid, threadsPerBlock, 0, *stream>>>(scores, batch, seqQ, seqKV);
    80	 DebugHelper::checkGlobalErrorCode("applyCausalMaskInPlace failed");
    81	}

    84	                     (const int blocksPerGrid, const int threadsPerBlock, const cudaStream_t* stream,
    85	                      void* vScores, LongType batch, LongType seqQ, LongType seqKV),
    86	                     SD_FLOAT_TYPES);

    88	// Public interface
    89	void applyCausalMaskCuda(NDArray* scores, LaunchContext* context) {
    90	 auto stream = context->getCudaStream();
    91	 const auto batch = scores->sizeAt(0);
    92	 const auto seqQ = scores->sizeAt(1);
    93	 const auto seqKV = scores->sizeAt(2);
    94	
    95	 const LongType totalElements = batch * seqQ * seqKV;
    96	 const int blockSize = 256;
    97	 const int numBlocks = (totalElements + blockSize - 1) / blockSize;
    98	
    99	 NDArray::prepareSpecialUse({scores}, {scores});
   100	
   101	 BUILD_SINGLE_SELECTOR(scores->dataType(), applyCausalMaskInPlaceLauncher,
   102	                       (numBlocks, blockSize, stream, scores->specialBuffer(), batch, seqQ, seqKV),
   103	                       SD_FLOAT_TYPES);
   104	
   105	 NDArray::registerSpecialUse({scores}, {scores});
   106	}

   108	//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   109	// Fused causal mask + softmax kernel
   110	// Each block handles one row (batch*seqQ rows total, each of length seqKV)
   111	// Fuses: causal mask application + row-wise softmax
   112	//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   113	template <typename T>
   114	__global__ void fusedCausalMaskSoftmaxKernel(
   115	   const T* __restrict__ input,   // [batch, seqQ, seqKV] - logits from Q@K^T
   116	   T* __restrict__ output,        // [batch, seqQ, seqKV] - softmax output
   117	   T* __restrict__ logitsOut,     // [batch, seqQ, seqKV] - masked logits (optional)
   118	   const LongType batch,
   119	   const LongType seqQ,
   120	   const LongType seqKV,
   121	   const bool isCausal) {
   122	
   123	 const LongType row = blockIdx.x;  // which row (batch*seqQ rows)
   124	 if (row >= batch * seqQ) return;
   125	
   126	 const LongType queryIdx = row % seqQ;
   127	 const LongType rowStart = row * seqKV;
   128	 const LongType causalOffset = (seqKV > seqQ) ? (seqKV - seqQ) : 0;
   129	 const LongType queryPos = queryIdx + causalOffset;
   130	
   131	 extern __shared__ char sharedMem[];
   132	 float* sdata = reinterpret_cast<float*>(sharedMem);
   133	
   134	 // Pass 1: Apply causal mask and find max
   135	 float threadMax = -INFINITY;
   136	 const LongType maxKV = isCausal ? min(queryPos + 1, seqKV) : seqKV;
   137	
   138	 for (LongType j = threadIdx.x; j < seqKV; j += blockDim.x) {
   139	   float val;
   140	   if (isCausal && j > queryPos) {
   141	     val = -1.0e9f;
   142	   } else {
   143	     val = static_cast<float>(input[rowStart + j]);
   144	   }
   145	   // Store masked logits if requested
   146	   if (logitsOut != nullptr) {
   147	     logitsOut[rowStart + j] = static_cast<T>(val);
   148	   }
   149	   threadMax = fmaxf(threadMax, val);
   150	 }
   151	
   152	 // Warp reduce max
   153	 for (int offset = WARP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
   154	   threadMax = fmaxf(threadMax, __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffff, threadMax, offset));
   155	 }
   156	
   157	 const int lane = threadIdx.x % WARP_SIZE;
   158	 const int wid = threadIdx.x / WARP_SIZE;
   159	 const int numWarps = (blockDim.x + WARP_SIZE - 1) / WARP_SIZE;
   160	
   161	 if (lane == 0) sdata[wid] = threadMax;
   162	 __syncthreads();
   163	
   164	 float rowMax = -INFINITY;
   165	 if (threadIdx.x < numWarps) rowMax = sdata[threadIdx.x];
   166	 for (int offset = WARP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
   167	   rowMax = fmaxf(rowMax, __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffff, rowMax, offset));
   168	 }
   169	
   170	 __shared__ float sharedMax;
   171	 if (threadIdx.x == 0) sharedMax = rowMax;
   172	 __syncthreads();
   173	 rowMax = sharedMax;
   174	
   175	 // Pass 2: Compute exp(x - max) and sum
   176	 float threadSum = 0.0f;
   177	 for (LongType j = threadIdx.x; j < seqKV; j += blockDim.x) {
   178	   float val;
   179	   if (logitsOut != nullptr) {
   180	     val = static_cast<float>(logitsOut[rowStart + j]);
   181	   } else if (isCausal && j > queryPos) {
   182	     val = -1.0e9f;
   183	   } else {
   184	     val = static_cast<float>(input[rowStart + j]);
   185	   }
   186	   float expVal = expf(val - rowMax);
   187	   output[rowStart + j] = static_cast<T>(expVal);
   188	   threadSum += expVal;
   189	 }
   190	
   191	 // Warp reduce sum
   192	 for (int offset = WARP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
   193	   threadSum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffff, threadSum, offset);
   194	 }
   195	 if (lane == 0) sdata[wid] = threadSum;
   196	 __syncthreads();
   197	
   198	 float rowSum = 0.0f;
   199	 if (threadIdx.x < numWarps) rowSum = sdata[threadIdx.x];
   200	 for (int offset = WARP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
   201	   rowSum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffff, rowSum, offset);
   202	 }
   203	
   204	 __shared__ float sharedSum;
   205	 if (threadIdx.x == 0) sharedSum = rowSum;
   206	 __syncthreads();
   207	 float invSum = 1.0f / sharedSum;
   208	
   209	 // Pass 3: Normalize
   210	 for (LongType j = threadIdx.x; j < seqKV; j += blockDim.x) {
   211	   float expVal = static_cast<float>(output[rowStart + j]);
   212	   output[rowStart + j] = static_cast<T>(expVal * invSum);
   213	 }
   214	}
   215	
   216	template <typename T>
   217	static void fusedCausalMaskSoftmaxLauncher(const int blocksPerGrid, const int threadsPerBlock,
   218	                                          const int sharedMem, const cudaStream_t* stream,
   219	                                          const void* vInput, void* vOutput, void* vLogitsOut,
   220	                                          LongType batch, LongType seqQ, LongType seqKV, bool isCausal) {
   221	 auto input = reinterpret_cast<const T*>(vInput);
   222	 auto output = reinterpret_cast<T*>(vOutput);
   223	 auto logitsOut = vLogitsOut != nullptr ? reinterpret_cast<T*>(vLogitsOut) : nullptr;
   224	 fusedCausalMaskSoftmaxKernel<T><<<blocksPerGrid, threadsPerBlock, sharedMem, *stream>>>(
   225	     input, output, logitsOut, batch, seqQ, seqKV, isCausal);
   226	 DebugHelper::checkGlobalErrorCode("fusedCausalMaskSoftmax failed");
   227	}

   229	BUILD_SINGLE_TEMPLATE(void fusedCausalMaskSoftmaxLauncher,
   230	                     (const int blocksPerGrid, const int threadsPerBlock, const int sharedMem,
   231	                      const cudaStream_t* stream, const void* vInput, void* vOutput, void* vLogitsOut,
   232	                      LongType batch, LongType seqQ, LongType seqKV, bool isCausal),
   233	                     SD_FLOAT_TYPES);
   234	
   235	// Public interface for fused causal mask + softmax
   236	void fusedCausalMaskSoftmaxCuda(NDArray* input, NDArray* output, NDArray* logitsOut,
   237	                               bool isCausal, LaunchContext* context) {
   238	 auto stream = context->getCudaStream();
   239	 const auto batch = input->sizeAt(0);
   240	 const auto seqQ = input->sizeAt(1);
   241	 const auto seqKV = input->sizeAt(2);
   242	
   243	 const LongType numRows = batch * seqQ;
   244	 int threadsPerBlock = 256;
   245	 if (seqKV > 256) threadsPerBlock = 512;
   246	 if (seqKV > 512) threadsPerBlock = 1024;
   247	 if (seqKV < threadsPerBlock) {
   248	   threadsPerBlock = ((seqKV + WARP_SIZE - 1) / WARP_SIZE) * WARP_SIZE;
   249	   if (threadsPerBlock < WARP_SIZE) threadsPerBlock = WARP_SIZE;
   250	 }
   251	
   252	 int numWarps = (threadsPerBlock + WARP_SIZE - 1) / WARP_SIZE;
   253	 size_t sharedMemSize = numWarps * sizeof(float);
   254	
   255	 if (logitsOut != nullptr) {
   256	   NDArray::prepareSpecialUse({output, logitsOut}, {input});
   257	 } else {
   258	   NDArray::prepareSpecialUse({output}, {input});
   259	 }

    44	//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    45	// KVCache Implementation
    46	//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    47	
    48	KVCache::KVCache(LongType maxSeqLen, LongType numKvHeads, LongType headDim,
    49	                 LongType batchSize, DataType dtype)
    50	    : maxSeqLen_(maxSeqLen), numKvHeads_(numKvHeads), headDim_(headDim),
    51	      batchSize_(batchSize), currentLength_(0), dtype_(dtype) {
    52	
    53	  std::vector<LongType> cacheShape = {batchSize, maxSeqLen, numKvHeads, headDim};
    54	  keyCache_ = new NDArray('c', cacheShape, dtype);
    55	  valueCache_ = new NDArray('c', cacheShape, dtype);
    56	  keyCache_->nullify();
    57	  valueCache_->nullify();
    58	}
    59	
    60	KVCache::~KVCache() {
    61	  delete keyCache_;
    62	  delete valueCache_;
    63	}
    64	
    65	void KVCache::update(NDArray* newKeys, NDArray* newValues, LongType position) {
    66	  auto newSeqLen = newKeys->sizeAt(1);
    67	  if (position + newSeqLen > maxSeqLen_) {
    68	    THROW_EXCEPTION("KVCache: Cannot update beyond maximum sequence length");
    69	  }
    70	
    71	  auto keyCacheSlice = (*keyCache_)({0, batchSize_, position, position + newSeqLen, 0, numKvHeads_, 0, headDim_});
    72	  auto valueCacheSlice = (*valueCache_)({0, batchSize_, position, position + newSeqLen, 0, numKvHeads_, 0, headDim_});
    73	  keyCacheSlice->assign(newKeys);
    74	  valueCacheSlice->assign(newValues);
    75	  delete keyCacheSlice;
    76	  delete valueCacheSlice;
    77	
    78	  currentLength_ = std::max(currentLength_, position + newSeqLen);
    79	}

    81	NDArray* KVCache::getKeys(LongType seqLen) {
    82	  if (seqLen == 0 || seqLen > currentLength_) seqLen = currentLength_;
    83	  if (seqLen == maxSeqLen_) return keyCache_;
    84	  return (*keyCache_)({0, batchSize_, 0, seqLen, 0, numKvHeads_, 0, headDim_});
    85	}
    86	
    87	NDArray* KVCache::getValues(LongType seqLen) {
    88	  if (seqLen == 0 || seqLen > currentLength_) seqLen = currentLength_;
    89	  if (seqLen == maxSeqLen_) return valueCache_;
    90	  return (*valueCache_)({0, batchSize_, 0, seqLen, 0, numKvHeads_, 0, headDim_});
    91	}

    94	  keyCache_->nullify();
    95	  valueCache_->nullify();
    96	  currentLength_ = 0;
    97	}

   101	//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   102	// Flash Attention Forward - Supports both 3D and 4D inputs
   103	// 3D: [batch, seqLen, dim] - single head attention
   104	// 4D: [batch, seqLen, numHeads, headDim] - multi-head attention
   105	//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   106	
   107	void FlashAttentionHelper::forward(
   108	    NDArray* query, NDArray* key, NDArray* value,
   109	    NDArray* output, const Config& config,
   110	    NDArray* softmaxLse, NDArray* attentionScores,
   111	    NDArray* attentionLogits, LaunchContext* context,
   112	    NDArray* attentionBias) {
   113	
   114	  auto rank = query->rankOf();
   115	  REQUIRE_TRUE(rank == 3 || rank == 4, 0,
   116	               "FlashAttentionHelper::forward: query rank must be 3 or 4, got %i", rank);
   117	  REQUIRE_TRUE(key->rankOf() == rank && value->rankOf() == rank, 0,
   118	               "FlashAttentionHelper::forward: query, key, value must have same rank");
   119	
   120	  if (rank == 3) {
   121	    forward3D(query, key, value, output, config, softmaxLse, attentionScores, attentionLogits, context,
   122	              attentionBias);
   123	  } else {
   124	    forward4D(query, key, value, output, config, softmaxLse, attentionScores, attentionLogits, context,
   125	              attentionBias);
   126	  }
   127	}
   128	
   129	//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   130	// 3D Forward Implementation - [batch, seq, dim]
   131	// OPTIMIZED: Uses workspace buffers, minimal allocations
   132	//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   133	
   134	void FlashAttentionHelper::forward3D(
   135	    NDArray* query, NDArray* key, NDArray* value,
   136	    NDArray* output, const Config& config,
   137	    NDArray* softmaxLse, NDArray* attentionScores,
   138	    NDArray* attentionLogits, LaunchContext* context,
   139	    NDArray* attentionBias) {
   140	
   141	  auto batch = query->sizeAt(0);
   142	  auto seqLenQ = query->sizeAt(1);
   143	  auto dim = query->sizeAt(2);
   144	  auto seqLenKV = key->sizeAt(1);
   145	
   146	  float scale = config.scale > 0.0f ? config.scale : 1.0f / std::sqrt(static_cast<float>(dim));
   147	
   148	#if defined(SD_CUDA)
   149	  // Use fused CUDA kernel - now supports attention bias!
   150	  // cuBLAS matmuls are only faster when we need intermediate score results
   151	  bool supportedType = (query->dataType() == DataType::FLOAT32 ||
   152	                        query->dataType() == DataType::DOUBLE ||
   153	                        query->dataType() == DataType::HALF);
   154	  bool needScores = (attentionScores != nullptr && !attentionScores->isEmpty());
   155	  bool needLogits = (attentionLogits != nullptr && !attentionLogits->isEmpty());
   156	
   157	  if (supportedType && !needScores && !needLogits) {
   158	    // Use fast fused kernel - handles attention bias internally
   159	    fusedAttentionCuda(query, key, value, output, scale, config.isCausal, context, attentionBias);
   160	    if (softmaxLse != nullptr) {
   161	      softmaxLse->nullify();
   162	    }
   163	    return;
   164	  }
   165	  // Fall through to cuBLAS path when scores are needed
   166	#endif
   167	
   168	  // Get workspace for scores buffer - REUSED across calls
   169	  auto workspace = AttentionWorkspace::getInstance();
   170	  std::vector<LongType> scoresShape = {batch, seqLenQ, seqLenKV};
   171	
   172	  // Determine which array to use for computation
   173	  NDArray* logitsBuffer = nullptr;
   174	  NDArray* workBuffer = nullptr;
   175	
   176	  if (attentionLogits != nullptr && !attentionLogits->isEmpty()) {
   177	    logitsBuffer = attentionLogits;
   178	  }
   179	
   180	  // Use attentionScores if provided, otherwise get from workspace
   181	  if (attentionScores != nullptr && !attentionScores->isEmpty()) {
   182	    workBuffer = attentionScores;
   183	  } else {
   184	    // Get reusable buffer from workspace - NO ALLOCATION if shape matches previous call
   185	    workBuffer = workspace->getBuffer("forward3d_scores", scoresShape, query->dataType(), context);
   186	  }
   187	
   188	  // Batched matmul: Q @ K^T with scale -> [batch, seqQ, seqKV]
   189	  MmulHelper::matmul(query, key, workBuffer, false, true, scale, 0.0);
   190	
   191	  if (attentionBias != nullptr && !attentionBias->isEmpty()) {
   192	    NDArray* biasForAdd = attentionBias;
   193	    std::unique_ptr<NDArray> biasPermutedOwner;
   194	    std::unique_ptr<NDArray> biasReshapedOwner;
   195	
   196	    // Some ONNX exports provide additive attention bias as [..., seqKV, seqQ]
   197	    // (source,target) instead of [..., seqQ, seqKV]. Normalize by swapping the
   198	    // trailing dimensions when needed.
   199	    if (seqLenQ != seqLenKV &&
   200	        biasForAdd->rankOf() >= 2 &&
   201	        biasForAdd->sizeAt(biasForAdd->rankOf() - 2) == seqLenKV &&
   202	        biasForAdd->sizeAt(biasForAdd->rankOf() - 1) == seqLenQ) {
   203	      std::vector<LongType> perm(static_cast<size_t>(biasForAdd->rankOf()));
   204	      for (int i = 0; i < biasForAdd->rankOf(); i++) perm[static_cast<size_t>(i)] = i;
   205	      std::swap(perm[perm.size() - 2], perm[perm.size() - 1]);
   206	      biasPermutedOwner.reset(biasForAdd->permute(perm, false, false));
   207	      biasForAdd = biasPermutedOwner.get();
   208	    }
   209	
   210	    // Common ONNX case for 3D attention bias: [batch,1,seqQ,seqKV] -> [batch,seqQ,seqKV]
   211	    if (biasForAdd->rankOf() == 4 && biasForAdd->sizeAt(1) == 1) {
   212	      std::vector<LongType> biasShape3d = {biasForAdd->sizeAt(0), biasForAdd->sizeAt(2), biasForAdd->sizeAt(3)};
   213	      biasReshapedOwner.reset(biasForAdd->reshape('c', biasShape3d));
   214	      biasForAdd = biasReshapedOwner.get();
   215	    }
   216	
   217	    workBuffer->applyTrueBroadcast(sd::BroadcastOpsTuple::Add(), biasForAdd, workBuffer, false);
   218	  }
   219	
   220	#if defined(SD_CUDA)

One nuance I’m confirming for the final writeup: `onnx_multi_head_attention` does pass `block.launchContext()` into FlashAttention, but `matmul` hands off to `MmulHelper::matmul(...)` without a `Context*` argument. If that helper is using array-level CUDA context instead of the op `Context`, then the launch-context theory is even weaker for the matmul path than for attention.

codex
The matmul branch weakens the launch-context theory further: the custom `matmul` op does not pass `block.launchContext()` into `MmulHelper`; CUDA `MmulHelper` code pulls stream/handle from `A->getContext()`, i.e. the arrays’ context, not the op `Context`. For attention, `block.launchContext()` still matters because it is passed into `FlashAttentionHelper`, but even there the stream comes from `LaunchContext::getCudaStream()`, which in this codebase resolves to the default thread-local execution stream, not `tl_dspExecutionStream`. I’m checking one last thing: whether DSP can actually vary `numActualOutputs` or optional input presence on the same pooled context.

**Findings**
- The strongest code-backed difference is DSP pooled `Context` reuse without purge. In [Context.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/Context.cpp:680), `width()`/`outputWidth()` are just `fastpath_in/out.size()`, and `setInputArray()` / `setOutputArray()` only grow those vectors; they never shrink them ([Context.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/Context.cpp:691)). Standard Java pooled contexts do purge before reuse: [CudaOpContext.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/nd4j-backends/nd4j-backend-impls/nd4j-cuda/src/main/java/org/nd4j/linalg/jcublas/ops/executioner/CudaOpContext.java:360) calls `ctxPurgeNoSync()`, which maps to `clearFastPathNoSync()` in [NativeOpsHelpers_DataBuffers.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/legacy/impl/NativeOpsHelpers_DataBuffers.cpp:141) and [Context.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/Context.cpp:1015). DSP allocates `contextPool_` with `new Context(1)` and reuses it, but I did not find any DSP-side purge ([NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:870), [NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp:2344)).
- That matters directly for `onnx_multi_head_attention`. The op decides whether optional inputs exist from `block.width()` and whether present-K/V outputs exist from `block.outputWidth()` ([onnx_multi_head_attention.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/ops/declarable/generic/nn/onnx_multi_head_attention.cpp:67)). `INPUT_VARIABLE(n)` is just `block.array(n)` and `OUTPUT_VARIABLE(n)` is `getZ(block,n)` ([op_boilerplate.h](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/system/op_boilerplate.h:2733)). `Context::array()` / `DeclarableOp::getZ()` return whatever pointer is sitting in `fastpath_in/out[n]` if the vector is long enough ([Context.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/Context.cpp:570), [DeclarableOp.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/ops/declarable/impl/DeclarableOp.cpp:260)). So stale tail entries change control flow and tensor selection inside MHA even when required Q/K/V and args match.
- DSP frozen execution refreshes inputs but not outputs. In the frozen path it explicitly rewrites current inputs, then executes against the existing `ctx.fastpath_out()` ([NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp:1342)). If an output pointer changed after warmup, the context can keep using stale outputs.
- Warmup DSP only sets the first `numActualOutputs`, where `numActualOutputs = min(slot.wiring.numOutputs, outputShapes.size())` ([NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp:1951), [NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp:2350)). That makes stale output tail entries possible whenever actual output count shrinks.
- `VariableSpace` is not the differentiator. Standard Java custom-op execution also uses `createGraphContext(1)` ([CudaOpContext.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/nd4j-backends/nd4j-backend-impls/nd4j-cuda/src/main/java/org/nd4j/linalg/jcublas/ops/executioner/CudaOpContext.java:55)), and native `createGraphContext()` is just `new Context(nodeId)` with no `VariableSpace` ([NativeOpsHelpers_Arrays.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/legacy/impl/NativeOpsHelpers_Arrays.cpp:551)).

**What Context State Actually Matters**
- In [DeclarableOp.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/ops/declarable/impl/DeclarableOp.cpp:303), the real behavior-changing Context state is `isFastPath()`, `isInplace()`, `shapeFunctionOverride()`, `helpersAllowed()`, `launchContext()`, `workspace()`, `nodeId()`, and `getVariableSpace()` via `getZ()`, `prepareOutputs()`, helper dispatch, and overwrite logic. `DeclarableOp::execute()` does not dispatch on `opNum()`, `executionMode()`, `isTraining()/isInference()`, or `ctx.dataType()`.
- `onnx_multi_head_attention` reads `block.width()`, `block.outputWidth()`, args, and `block.launchContext()`; it does not read `isInplace()`, `dataType()`, `opNum()`, or `VariableSpace` ([onnx_multi_head_attention.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/ops/declarable/generic/nn/onnx_multi_head_attention.cpp:67)).
- `matmul` also does not read `isInplace()`, `dataType()`, `opNum()`, or `executionMode()`. It only reads arrays and args, then calls `MmulHelper::matmul(...)` ([matmul.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/ops/declarable/generic/blas/matmul.cpp:35)). `_opNum` matters for legacy wrappers, not this custom op ([LegacyTransformStrictOp.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/ops/declarable/impl/LegacyTransformStrictOp.cpp:44)).

**Launch Context**
- The stream/handle theory is weaker than the stale-fastpath theory. `onnx_multi_head_attention` passes `block.launchContext()` into FlashAttention ([FlashAttentionHelper.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/helpers/impl/FlashAttentionHelper.cpp:107), [FlashAttentionHelper.cu](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/helpers/cuda/FlashAttentionHelper.cu:89)), but [LaunchContext.cu](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/execution/cuda/LaunchContext.cu:197) shows `getCublasHandle()` comes from `CublasHelper` and `getCudaStream()` ignores external stream pointers in favor of thread-local `contextBuffers.execStream()` ([LaunchContext.cu](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/execution/cuda/LaunchContext.cu:201)).
- `DspStreamGuard` only sets `tl_dspExecutionStream` ([DspStreamGuard.h](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/DspStreamGuard.h:54)), and that stream is used in the H2D copy path in [DataBuffer.cu](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/array/cuda/DataBuffer.cu:953), not by `LaunchContext::getCudaStream()`.
- For `matmul`, CUDA helper code uses the arrays’ own context (`A->getContext()->getCudaStream()/getCublasHandle()`), not the op `Context` ([MmulHelper.cu](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/helpers/cuda/MmulHelper.cu:932)).

Most likely root cause from the inspected source: DSP pooled `Context` objects keep stale `fastpath_in/out` size and pointers, and `onnx_multi_head_attention` uses those sizes to decide whether optional past/present-KV paths exist. The fastest discriminator to inspect next is the failing attention slot: compare `slot.wiring.numInputs` vs `ctx.fastpath_in().size()` and `numActualOutputs` vs `ctx.fastpath_out().size()`. If those differ, DSP and standard are not executing the same logical MHA signature.
